{{Top|leg}}
'''Zone 90 East''' was an orbital parking site just outside of [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant's]] [[Planetary shield/Legends|planetary shield]] during the [[Black Fleet Crisis]]. It was within sight of a military space station that served it, allowing for crews and supplies of the [[New Republic Fifth Fleet|Fifth Fleet]] to flow through. The Fifth Fleet remained here before its departure for the [[Deep Core/Legends|Deep Core]] while beings streamed in from [[Eastport/Legends|Eastport]], [[Westport]], and [[Newport]].<ref name="BtS">''[[Before the Storm]]''</ref>
